_comment: Branch ruleset for `main`, kept in the repo so the protection is reviewable and
reproducible instead of living only in the GitHub UI.
This file is the TARGET state: it lists codecov/patch and codecov/project as required
status checks. They are NOT required on the live ruleset yet, because Codecov rejects
tokenless uploads and a required check that can never report blocks every merge
forever. Add the CODECOV_TOKEN secret first (see the README), confirm both statuses
actually post on a PR, then apply this file:
Until then the merge gate is the diff-cover step inside the `server tests + coverage`
job, which enforces the same 80% patch-coverage rule without a third-party service.
required_approving_review_count is 0 on purpose: GitHub does not let you approve your
own pull request, so on a single-maintainer repo any higher number blocks every merge.
name: Protect main
